02-policiaco.title: Policía Nacional's search has no label.
02-policiaco.alt: Real run, national card. Policía Nacional's search has no label. Overall score 78 of 100. SEO 67, GEO 86, Analytics 85, Security 77, A11y 71, Speed 82. www.policia.gov.co, 20 pages analyzed, 21 Oct 2026.
02-policiaco.linkedin:
Policía Nacional's search has no label.

HSTS with preload, framing limited to its own origin, a declared language, and every internal link opened answered. But the home page search box and volume slider have no label, so screen readers announce blank fields.

The lesson for every team: Tie each field to a <label for>, or give it an aria-label. A screen reader can only announce a name that exists.

One automated analysis of public pages on 21 Oct 2026. A starting point, not a verdict.

es.title: El buscador de la Policía Nacional no tiene etiqueta.
es.alt: Ejecución real, tarjeta nacional. El buscador de la Policía Nacional no tiene etiqueta. Puntuación general: 78 de 100. SEO 67, GEO 86, Analítica 85, Seguridad 77, A11y 71, Velocidad 82. www.policia.gov.co, 20 páginas analizadas, 21 oct. 2026.
es.linkedin:
El buscador de la Policía Nacional no tiene etiqueta.

HSTS con preload, framing limitado a su propio origen, un idioma declarado y todos los enlaces internos abiertos respondieron. Pero el buscador y el control de volumen de la home no tienen etiqueta, así que los lectores de pantalla anuncian campos en blanco.

La lección para cualquier equipo: Asocia cada campo a un <label for>, o dale un aria-label. Un lector de pantalla solo puede anunciar un nombre que existe.

Un análisis automatizado de páginas públicas el 21 oct. 2026. Un punto de partida, no un veredicto.

SEO 47, GEO 86, Analytics 85, Security 77, A11y 71, Speed 64. www.wto.org, 20 pages analyzed, 21 Oct 2026. Lesson: Add a viewport meta tag with width=device-width, initial-scale=1, then test on a phone.
05-wto.linkedin:
WTO: no viewport tag on the start page.

HSTS is on, framing is limited to the same origin, and DMARC rejects spoofed mail. But the start page has no viewport meta tag, so phones draw the desktop layout zoomed out, and Google indexes mobile first.

The lesson for every team: Add a viewport meta tag with width=device-width, initial-scale=1, then test on a phone.

20-pasto.linkedin:
Pasto sends each visit to two GA4 properties.

Made-up paths get a real 404, the page text is in the HTML, and the start page declares Spanish for Colombia. But every page analyzed loads gtag.js twice, for two GA4 IDs, so one visit can land in two reports.

The lesson for every team: Keep one GA4 property per site, loaded once, ideally through Tag Manager, and retire the old ID.

The lesson for every team: Publish SPF for the senders you use and a DMARC policy. Start at p=none with reports, then tighten.

36-monteria.linkedin:
Montería's pages can't be zoomed.

One-year HSTS with preload, nosniff, a content security policy, alt text on every image, and a permanent https redirect. But the viewport tag sets user-scalable=no, so people on phones can't pinch to zoom.

The lesson for every team: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag. Low-vision visitors rely on zoom.

The lesson for every team: Pick one host, 301 the other to it, and keep canonicals and the sitemap there.

61-shopify.title: Shopify: rich entity, but frameable.
61-shopify.alt: Real run, worldwide card. Shopify: rich entity, but frameable. Overall score 90 of 100. SEO 94, GEO 94, Analytics 97, Security 75, A11y 97, Speed 88. www.shopify.com, 20 pages analyzed, 21 Oct 2026. Lesson: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' on pages that no partner needs to embed.
61-shopify.linkedin:
Shopify: rich entity, but frameable.

A Corporation entity with seven sameAs links, an llms.txt, security.txt, and HSTS with preload. But the pages analyzed send neither X-Frame-Options nor a CSP frame-ancestors, so any site can frame them.

The lesson for every team: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' on pages that no partner needs to embed.

One automated analysis of public pages on 21 Oct 2026. A starting point, not a verdict.

66-insco.linkedin:
INS stops visitors from zooming in.

Every internal link opened answered, real 404s, framing limited, and a declared language. But the viewport tag sets maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no, so people with low vision cannot pinch to zoom on a phone.

The lesson for every team: Drop maximum-scale and user-scalable=no from the viewport tag. Let people zoom; the layout can cope.

de.title: INS hindert Besucher am Zoomen.
de.alt: Echter Lauf, nationale Karte. INS hindert Besucher am Zoomen. Gesamtwert 62 von 100. SEO 51, GEO 86, Analytics 85, Sicherheit 32, A11y 53, Tempo 76. www.ins.gov.co, 20 Seiten analysiert, 21. Okt. 2026.
de.linkedin:
INS hindert Besucher am Zoomen.

Jeder geöffnete interne Link antwortete, echte 404-Antworten, begrenztes Framing und eine deklarierte Sprache. Doch das Viewport-Tag setzt maximum-scale=1 und user-scalable=no, also können sehbehinderte Menschen am Smartphone nicht per Pinch zoomen.

Die Lektion für jedes Team: Entfernen Sie maximum-scale und user-scalable=no aus dem Viewport-Tag. Lassen Sie Menschen zoomen; das Layout hält das aus.

Eine automatisierte Analyse öffentlicher Seiten am 21. Okt. 2026. Ein Ausgangspunkt, kein Urteil.

fr.linkedin:
L’INS empêche les visiteurs de zoomer.

67-caricom.linkedin:
CARICOM's SPF record starts with a quote.

Structured data parses, share cards are complete, and DMARC quarantines spoofed mail. But the SPF TXT record begins with a stray quote mark and is split in two, so mail servers read no SPF at all.

The lesson for every team: Publish one TXT record that starts exactly with v=spf1 and lists every sender, then test it.

de.linkedin:
CARICOMs SPF-Eintrag beginnt mit einem Anführungszeichen.

Die strukturierten Daten sind parsbar, die Share-Cards vollständig, und DMARC stellt gefälschte Mails unter Quarantäne. Doch der SPF-TXT-Record beginnt mit einem verirrten Anführungszeichen und ist zweigeteilt, also lesen Mailserver gar kein SPF.

Die Lektion für jedes Team: Veröffentlichen Sie einen TXT-Eintrag, der genau mit v=spf1 beginnt und jeden Absender listet, und testen Sie ihn.

CABEI's missing pages answer 200, not 404.

HSTS runs a full year, DMARC is enforced, framing is limited, and every image has alt text. But a made-up address answers 200 instead of 404, so crawlers can index error pages as real ones.

The lesson for every team: Return a real 404 status for unknown paths, with a helpful page, so search engines drop dead URLs.

es.linkedin:
Las páginas inexistentes de CABEI responden 200, no 404.

HSTS dura un año completo, DMARC se aplica, el framing está limitado y cada imagen tiene texto alt. Pero una dirección inventada responde 200 en vez de 404, así que los rastreadores pueden indexar páginas de error como si fueran reales.

La lección para cualquier equipo: Devuelve un estado 404 real para rutas desconocidas, con una página útil, para que los buscadores descarten las URLs muertas.

83-gencat.linkedin:
Catalonia's robots.txt blocks AI answers.

DMARC rejects spoofed mail, HSTS runs a year, and every image on the home page has alt text. But robots.txt opens with Disallow: / for any crawler it does not name, so bots like OAI-SearchBot stay out.

The lesson for every team: Name the search and AI answer crawlers you want in robots.txt, so citations can point back to you.

An NGO entity in JSON-LD, DMARC set to reject, framing limited, and language versions that link back. But three scripts sit in the <head> of /en without async or defer, so nothing paints until they load.

CA.gov scores 92, DMARC only watches.

The lesson for every team: After reviewing DMARC reports, move to p=quarantine and then p=reject, so forged mail is blocked.

Every image has alt text, Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors, and DMARC is enforced. But pages name http:// URLs as their canonical, so search engines are told to prefer unencrypted URLs.

The lesson for every team: Point every canonical at the final https URL, the same one you list in the sitemap.

106-isaco.linkedin:
ISA's home page has no h1 and no main.

Structured data that parses, full share cards, HSTS, and DMARC that guards its mail. But the home page has no h1 and no <main> landmark, so screen-reader users get no heading or region to jump to.

The lesson for every team: Wrap the content in one <main> and give the page one h1. They are the two shortcuts screen readers lean on most.

it.linkedin:
